title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents
author: Run-Ze Fan, Zihao Zhang, Simin Ma, Yebowen Hu, Shouju Wang, Kaiqiang Song, Fei Liu, Hamed Zamani, Xiaoyang Wang (synthesized by Brain Harness)

claims.assertion: Context management value scales inversely with window budget: at 32k budget without management (T0), agents catastrophically collapse (6.4%–12.6% SR, median 20–30 turns, dying at localization); rule-based elision (T1) rescues success to 20.6%–64.4% by sustaining 50–180 turns into verification.
claims.source: Fan et al. (arXiv:2609.20804v1, 2026), Section 3.2, Table 3 & Figure 32

claims.assertion: Staging rule-based elision (M1) at soft threshold B1 (0.60 usable window) before LLM summarization (M3) at hard threshold B2 (0.85 usable window) provides optimal token efficiency, minimizing expensive summarization calls while strictly bounding peak context.
claims.source: Fan et al. (arXiv:2609.20804v1, 2026), Section 2.3 (Algorithm 1), Section 3.2 & Figure 5

claims.assertion: Recoverable elision (M2 recall_event) adds complex external storage machinery that agents rarely invoke (<0.1% of turns) and yields zero statistically significant accuracy gain over irreversible elision (p > 0.05 across all models on SWE-Bench and Terminal-Bench).
claims.source: Fan et al. (arXiv:2609.20804v1, 2026), Section 3.2, Table 3, Table 4 & Appendix C.6

claims.assertion: Planning exhibits a capability duality: for weaker models (Nemotron-3 30B), it acts as an accuracy scaffold (raising SWE-Bench SR from 14% to 25% by preventing premature termination, dropping unedited runs from 68.6% to 27.8%); for stronger models (Nemotron-3 550B, Mistral-Medium-3.5), it acts as a cost saver (cutting trajectory length by 23%–31% and cost by 25%–48% by truncating redundant post-edit verification loops).
claims.source: Fan et al. (arXiv:2609.20804v1, 2026), Section 3.2, Table 5, Table 6, Figure 8 & Figure 9

claims.assertion: Action space optimal boundary depends on model capability and workload shell-centricity: predefined tools prevent syntax/interface hallucinations for weaker models; bash-only enables capable models on terminal-centric tasks to compose dense scripts, cutting re-patches from 4.6 to 1.5 and costs by 30%–53%.
claims.source: Fan et al. (arXiv:2609.20804v1, 2026), Section 3.2, Table 4, Table 7 & Figure 7
